name: html-artifact
description: Editorial style guide for one-off, single-file reviewable HTML *artifacts* (RFCs, design docs, code reviews, postmortems, ADRs, plans). Single self-contained file with section-reviewed checkboxes, per-section comments, decision queue, text-range annotations, multi-element selection, right-click annotate, baseline export formats, and a JSON companion file on disk for live agent monitoring. NOT for production web apps or customer-facing UIs.
